m1.typescript: m1 the mention workflow answers only claude comments and holds no key

e1.typescript: e1 the review workflow reads the code and posts the review

e2.typescript: e2 each prompt file carries a version that its changelog explains

e3.typescript: e3 the review guidance and the git workflow are files the reviewer and claude read

e4.typescript: e4 every run is bounded by turns time and concurrency

e5.typescript: e5 no file holds a key a personal path or an address

wrong-mention-unguarded.defect: starts a runner on every comment instead of only on @claude mentions

wrong-mention-beta.defect: uses the beta action instead of v1

wrong-review-writes.defect: gives the review job write access to the contents

wrong-review-no-comment.defect: runs the review without --comment, so nothing is posted

wrong-review-no-checkout.defect: runs the review skill without checking the repository out

wrong-review-types.defect: reviews only opened and updated pull requests, not reopened or ready ones

wrong-review-no-plugin.defect: names the review skill but never installs the plugin that provides it

wrong-prompt-version-mismatch.defect: leaves the changelog on an older version than the prompt

wrong-prompt-no-version.defect: drops the version from the prompt file

wrong-review-no-skip.defect: has no Skip section in the review guidance

wrong-main-allowed.defect: leaves out the rule never to commit to main

wrong-timeout-too-long.defect: gives the mention job a timeout of an hour

wrong-review-no-cancel.defect: lets a running review finish after a new push

wrong-key-in-notes.defect: writes an API key into the git workflow notes

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the changelog

wrong-email-address.defect: writes a real looking email address into the review guidance
